title: Blasts Rattle Riyadh as Saudi Arabia Hit by Deadliest Houthi Attacks So Far
summary_full: The Saudi authorities said they intercepted two missiles targeting Riyadh, a day after they said Houthi strikes on airports in the kingdom killed three people.
